content.short: Vyper is a Pythonic smart contract language for writing secure and readable EVM contracts.
content.description: Vyper is a Pythonic language for writing smart contracts, introduced in 2017 as a readable, security-focused alternative to Solidity for EVM-based contracts. It emphasizes safety features such as bounds and overflow checks, contract decidability, and strong typing to help produce secure and auditable code. It is not meant to fully replace Solidity but to complement it and enhance security. More than 10,000 smart contracts have been published with Vyper.
content.meta: Vyper is a Pythonic smart contract language for writing EVM contracts with safety and readability. Discover Vyper and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
